question_text: Outline what it means for a data warehouse to contain integrated data from several museum branches.
adaptation_rationale: Reframes old integrated database terminology as the explicit integrated-data role of warehouses.
solution: Data from the branches is combined into a unified representation, with compatible identifiers/formats, so analysis can compare records across branches.
